head: codex/5819-v092-repository-migration-preflight
title: [v0.92][WP-02] Copy company repositories without changing sources
body:
Closes #5819

## Outcome

Creates exactly five independent company-owned repository copies under `agent-logic`: four private repositories and public `agent-design-language`. All seven `danielbaustin` source repositories remain present and unchanged; `asksifu` and `Horust` received no destinations.

## Safety and proof

- destination Actions were disabled before the first mirrored ref and remain disabled for the cold copies
- every approved branch, tag, and supported note ref was copied explicitly without repository transfer or `git push --mirror`
- exact Git ref parity and a proven no-LFS disposition are retained for all five copies
- source-before/source-after evidence proves the five copied sources and both negative controls remained unchanged
- 37 non-Git GitHub surfaces have explicit evidence-backed dispositions without claiming issues, pull requests, settings, secrets, packages, or integrations were copied
- the two pre-Team historical gates retain authenticated unedited attestations and explicit supersession maps; overwritten old bytes are disclosed as unavailable and are not claimed as revalidated
- website reference updates remain isolated in gated sidecar #5888

## Focused validation

- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5819/validate-migration-evidence.rb`: PASS, five destinations, seven immutable sources, 37 disposition surfaces
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5819/verify-live-repositories.rb`: PASS, live organization confirmation, destination settings, exact refs, historical gate attestations, and two untouched controls
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: PASS
- independent exact-head review at `934f0d7cb3b7aa2007dbf382ef7be1914e3b6177`: PASS, no actionable findings

No broad test suite was run because this is a repository-operations and retained-evidence change, not a product-code change.
